document.about: Multi-Plastics 7500 PLA film product information sheet (2 pages, Word 2013). Page 1 sets a cutaway of the film as a picture, its layers named in text set over it: `Heat Sealable PLA Layer`, `PLA Core`, `Heat Sealable PLA Layer`, the last half off the picture's lower edge. The next section's heading, `Environmental Certifications`, stands under it.

notes: #201: drawn as an image, the cutaway drew no shapes, so no figure was found and its labels read as the page's paragraphs, between the applications list and the next heading.

checks.issue: `PLA Core`, a layer's name set on the cutaway, was a paragraph.
`Heat Sealable PLA Layer`, both outer layers' name on the cutaway, was a paragraph, the lower one half off the picture's edge.
A guard: `Environmental Certifications`, under the picture, is the next section's heading and no label of it.
